{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding sentinel -1 values): {mean_age:.2f} years')"}
